items.acceptance_condition: Owners and approval state are explicit; any numeric constraint has an approved rationale and source.
items.acquisition_method: Request and record an owner-approved operational decision with evidence and rationale.
evidence_currently_available: Validation AP/ROC-AUC and exploratory precision-recall analyses; these are selection-conditioned and do not define business requirements.
items.exact_missing_evidence: Approved objective, action policy, acceptable missed-fraud risk, false-positive/customer-impact constraints, and review capacity.
items.expected_output: Versioned decision records for DEC-OPS-01 through DEC-OPS-04.
items.why_necessary: Required to translate ranking evidence into an acceptance objective and any operational threshold policy.

items.acceptance_condition: Label rules, maturity cutoff, unresolved-label handling, source, chronology, and custody are documented and approved.
items.acquisition_method: Request label process documentation and a data-availability assessment before any cohort extraction.
evidence_currently_available: Existing historical split/evaluation reports document the development cohort only; no qualifying new cohort is confirmed in M6.
items.exact_missing_evidence: Label-generation/adjudication provenance, label-maturity delay, unresolved-label policy, and an eligible later or independently governed evaluation population.

items.potential_source: Data custodian and fraud-label operations; no source-system availability is established.
items.why_necessary: Prevents treating immature or unresolved labels as negatives and establishes valid evaluation timing/population.

items.acceptance_condition: Every feature has a documented source and scoring-time availability; population, exclusions, deduplication, and custody are specified.
items.acquisition_method: Request source lineage, timestamps, extraction specification, and feature availability attestations; do not infer them from names.
evidence_currently_available: Current inference contract, ordered features, scaler/sequence requirements, and prior validation data hashes are documented in existing artifacts.
items.exact_missing_evidence: Point-in-time availability evidence for each feature, source/extraction provenance for a future cohort, duplicate/overlap rules, and representativeness criteria.
items.expected_output: Versioned data provenance and feature availability assessment.
items.owner_role: Data owner / security and privacy roles
items.potential_source: Data owner/custodian and feature-source documentation; existence not verified.
items.why_necessary: Needed to rule out post-outcome leakage and determine whether a future cohort represents the intended operating population.

items.acceptance_condition: Policy references approved objective, rationale, evidence, method, cohort separation, and authorized approval; M5 engine semantics remain unchanged.

items.acceptance_condition: All evidence required by approved policy is linked, limitations are reported, and authorized decision-makers record disposition.

prerequisites.item: Approved evaluation objective, action mode, and acceptance rationale.
Defined target population, chronological boundaries, and mature-label/unresolved-label policy.
Data provenance, point-in-time feature availability, deduplication/overlap, and representativeness rules.
Frozen canonical artifact/hash, metadata, lineage class, scaler, inference code, metric definitions, and policy.
Prespecified candidate/comparison/exclusion rules and uncertainty method.
Disjoint eligible cohort with mature labels and governed access.
If threshold decisions are required, separate calibration method/cohort and threshold freeze before confirmation.
Validity criteria, reporting requirements, and explicit decision authority.
